faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR IARI Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow positions at ICAR IARI is 05-09-2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Junior Research Fellow post by ICAR IARI.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Masters degree in Plant Physiology, Agricultural Physics, Environmental Sciences, Agronomy, or Data Science, along with NET (CSIR, UGC, ICAR) or GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years. Age relaxations are applicable for OBC, SC, ST, and women candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 37,000 plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the ICAR IARI Junior Research Fellow recruitment must be submitted via email.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category of candidates applying for these positions.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview for the Junior Research Fellow positions will be conducted on 11-09-2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute located?
faq.answer: The ICAR Indian Agricultural Research Institute is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110012.
